premises.text: African children need tools to become technology creators rather than only consumers, given very low computer-science school outcomes
premises.evidence_span: These children need not only be passive consumers of technology, but also become creators and innovators of it

premises.text: Graphical programming blocks and game puzzles make coding concepts easy and intuitive for kids aged about 7–13
premises.evidence_span: It presents code concepts, which is primarily presumed as very complicated things in graphical programming blocks, which are very easy and intuitive to use

premises.text: Unlike Hopscotch, Tynker, Code.org, and Scratch, the app works offline and targets African markets with low internet penetration
premises.evidence_span: our application works fully offline, ensuring inclusivity in regions where internet penetration is very low

premises.text: AR game scenes make lessons more interactive
premises.evidence_span: a game scene, which is either a normal game scene or an AR, which we build to make the learning process much more interactive

premises.text: Monetization is an in-app character store plus branded mascot/environment placements for companies
premises.evidence_span: our other source of revenue is branded characters, where companies and brands can feature their branded mascots or environment in our app

value.text: Kids learn programming fundamentals in an easy, fun, interactive way
value.evidence_span: Programming has never been this easy and fun

causal_links.evidence_span: coding would play a huge role in helping them prosper in this tech-driven, rapidly changing world
graphical programming blocks, which are very easy and intuitive to use
branded characters, where companies and brands can feature their branded mascots

notes: Competitor comparison folded into offline/Africa positioning premise rather than separate premises. Blocky coins / character purchase treated as revenue mechanism detail within P5. Founder bio excluded.
